title: Learning to Say No
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: For most of my life, I found it impossible to say no. When classmates
asked to copy my homework, I let **them**. When my cousin asked me to
help with her online shop every weekend, I agreed, even though I had
exams. I thought saying yes made people like me. In fact, it only made
Things changed when my teacher, Mrs. Pim, noticed that I looked
exhausted. After class, she asked what was wrong. When I explained, **she**
told me something I still remember: "Every time you say yes to
something you don't want to do, you say no to something you do." **That**
made me realize how much time I was giving away.
I started small. I told my classmates I would explain the homework but
not let them copy **it**. To my surprise, most of them thanked me. My
cousin was upset at first, but now she pays a student to help her.
I still help people, but now I choose when and how.
